description: Missing beam parameters, then multi-turn completion and analysis

turns.message: Please analyze a simply supported beam.
The span is 6m with a 20kN/m downward uniformly distributed load over the full span. Discretize the beam at midspan with a connected analysis node and report the midspan vertical deflection.

assertions.description: The final response must report the requested midspan vertical deflection for the 6m beam under the 20kN/m UDL, with its value, sign, unit, and location consistent with the current analysis artifact; no independently invented or contradictory value is acceptable.
